name: LiveRegion
description: `Announce`, `AriaStatus`, and `AriaAlert` announce asynchronous changes without moving focus. They share one live-region implementation; `AriaStatus` and `AriaAlert` fix the politeness.

props.name: announceOnShow
props.description: Announces the content when the region first becomes visible, rather than only on later changes.

props.name: data-component
props.description: Overrides the marker used to identify this element in tests and styling.

props.name: delayMs
props.description: Delay before announcing, which lets rapidly changing content settle first.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the region visually while it keeps announcing to assistive technology.

props.name: politeness
props.description: Whether the announcement waits for a pause or interrupts immediately.
